C2M29|hush.text: The heart has stopped on its chain. The stair north of the bell is lit.
C2M29|hush.speaker: HULL

C2M28|caches.text: Health and armour lie along the highest step. Pick them up before the first stroke; after it there is no time.
C2M28|caches.speaker: HULL

C1E3M05|east.text: Another of the tall ones, a wheel of bells behind it. Anything near it takes half. Kill it first.
C1E3M05|east.speaker: INES
